title: This works great! Keeps water cold even in hot vehicle.
text: This works great! Keeps water cold even in hot vehicle.. Keeps water cold even in hot vehicles!  It works great!  It keeps hot liquids hot for at least 4 hours, warm for at least 8 hours.  I feel the price is kind of high for this item.  It does do what it is advertised to do and I do love having cold water when I get in my vehicle, although it has been sitting in there all day.  My feedback is  yes, buy it, if you can afford it.

product_metadata.title: BUILT 40 Ounce Prospect Double Wall Stainless Steel Bottle 40-ounce, Stainless Steel
features: GREAT FOR HOT AND COLD: The double-wall construction ensures both hot or cold drinks can be kept at optimum temperature for longer. It can keep your drinks cold for 24 hours and hot for 8 hours

INNOVATIVE DESIGN: Twist and flip-back cap design allows for quick and easy drinking while also preventing leaks and maintaining temperature. Innovative hinge lock keeps cap out of your way while drinking, locking it into place

DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: Made of high quality food grade 18/8 stainless steel, double wall vacuum-sealed construction which helps to prevent condensation from foaming on the outside of the tumbler. Features a carry handle integrated into the lid.
EASY TO CLEAN DESIGN: Super easy to clean lid is made from one part so there is nowhere for gunk to hide; top rack dishwasher safe lid, hand wash body
CAR CUP FRIENDLY: The bottle stands 12.2" tall and has a diameter of 3.54" which makes it size perfectly to fit in most cup holders.
WORRY LESS DRINKING: This tumbler is Food and Lead Safety tested plus it doesn't contain PVC, BPA, latex or phthalate; 40oz Capacity.

SUSTAINABILITY: Every year, billions of pounds of waste ends up in the oceans, and a vast majority of this trash is plastic meaning it will take thousands of years to decompose. Reusable water bottles are a convenient and environmentally friendly solution.
description: This BUILT Prospect Bottle is an ideal choice for a chilled or infused water but also just as suited to hold a warm hot chocolate or coffee for the commute. It can keep your drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 8 hours. The threaded lid has a one touch touch open and close that allows for an easy one handed operation. The main body of the bottle is double-wall stainless steel. The double-wall construction ensures both hot or cold drinks can be kept at optimum temperature for longer. Top rack dishwasher safe lid, hand wash body. Sized to fit in most standard cup holders. Food and Lead Safety tested plus it doesn't contain PVC, BPA, latex or phthalateand holds 40 ounces. With every BUILT reusable bottle purchased, you save money, keep hydrated and reduce plastic waste.
